name: notification-channels
purpose: Controls platform-wide notification routing for Slack, Discord, and Microsoft Teams without storing webhook URLs or tokens in git.

reader_guide.summary: Use this file to turn notification channels on or off and to choose which events each provider receives. Put real webhook URLs only in environment variables.
how_to_read: Read notifications_enabled first to see whether dispatch is globally allowed.
Read default_event_policy to understand default event and severity filtering.
Read channels to see provider-specific toggles and the environment variable name that must contain the webhook URL.
Read secret_policy before adding any field that could contain a token, webhook URL, or secret.
update_triggers: A new notification provider is added.
Slack, Discord, or Teams webhook payload requirements change.
A new platform event should notify the user.
Spec/source reconciliation needs a clarification_needed alert before implementation can continue.
A token handling or secret storage policy changes.

structure_rules.rule: Do not store webhook_url, token, secret, bearer_token, bot_token, or incoming_webhook fields in any channel entry.
structure_rules.reason: Webhook URLs are credentials and must not be committed to git.

structure_rules.rule: Each channel must point to a webhook_url_env value and the user supplies the actual value in their shell or local secret manager.
structure_rules.reason: The user can add or rotate tokens without editing tracked repository files.

structure_rules.rule: Provider-specific payload differences belong in agent_platform.integrations.notifications, not in ad hoc prompt text.
structure_rules.reason: Notification behavior should be testable and reusable across projects.

structure_rules.rule: Default notification execution should be dry-run unless the caller passes --send.
structure_rules.reason: Avoid accidental external messages during tests, evaluations, or prompt exploration.

field_guide.meaning: Global switch that allows or blocks notification dispatch even when individual channels are enabled.
Default event names, minimum severity, and dry-run behavior used when a channel does not override them.
Provider-specific notification routes with id, provider, enabled flag, event filter, severity filter, and webhook environment variable name.
Name of the environment variable that contains the real webhook URL. The value itself must not appear in this config.
Rules that prevent tokens and webhook URLs from being stored in the repository.

channels.setup_note: For new Teams setup, prefer a Workflows webhook URL. Existing Microsoft 365 connectors are a migration risk.

secret_policy.rotation_note: Rotate a provider webhook in the provider UI or secret manager, then update the local environment variable. Do not commit the actual URL.
